visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female doctor with short brown hair, wearing circular glasses and a white face mask, addresses the camera directly. She wears a brown top and a gold pendant. In the background, a patient lies on a white treatment table wearing protective silver eye goggles. A medical assistant in dark blue scrubs stands beside the patient, holding a white laser handpiece. The room is brightly lit with warm indoor lighting and clean medical surroundings. (2) The doctor holds a small white bottle and applies clear conductive gel onto the patient's face using a wooden spatula. The patient remains motionless. The camera focuses on the close-up interaction between the doctor's hands and the patient's skin. Bright text overlays appear in the lower center of the screen, highlighting key phrases in a variety-show style. (3) The assistant positions the BBL Hero laser device against the patient's cheek. As the device moves, intense flashes of white and orange light emanate from the tip. The doctor continues to gesture with her hands, explaining the process with an energetic expression visible through her eyes and forehead. (4) The scene concludes with a clean white graphic overlay. It displays the DRX Dermatology Clinic logo at the top center. Below, social media icons and text show the LINE ID, phone number, and physical addresses for locations in Sanchong and Zhongshan districts of Taipei and New Taipei City.
